description: The AI+ Pulse 2 is a feature-packed smartphone designed to keep you connected and entertained throughout your day. With its expansive 17.13 cm (6.745 inch) HD+ display featuring a modern punch-hole design, you'll enjoy immersive viewing experiences at 720 x 1600 pixels resolution. The device boasts a powerful 50MP rear camera with LED flash and full HD recording capabilities, perfect for capturing life's memorable moments in stunning detail, whilst the 8MP front camera ensures your selfies look their best. Powered by a Unisoc T7250 octa-core processor running at 1.8 GHz and operating on Android 16, this smartphone delivers smooth performance for multitasking and everyday use. Choose between 4GB RAM with 64GB storage or 6GB RAM with 128GB storage configurations, both expandable up to 1TB via dedicated memory card slot. The substantial 6000 mAh lithium polymer battery ensures extended usage without frequent charging. Stay connected with comprehensive network support including 4G VoLTE, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth V5.0, and GPS. Additional features include a fingerprint sensor, IP64 rating, dual SIM capability, 3.5mm audio jack, and OTG compatibility. Available in vibrant colours including Black
